title: Dual-Venue leg spec
description: A leg is defined ONCE and run by each venue whenever it is free (P1). legSpecSha256 in a receipt is the sha256 of this file's exact bytes, so editing a leg makes a new subject.

card.description: The card that declares this leg; venues.json roles are keyed by it.

clipId.description: A CONSENTED CLIP ID (never a path, never a tracked fixture: the fixtures are 2 and 16 frames and can never satisfy the owner's 20 s of real footage, so a fixture id is refused by the runner's admission gate, typed, and cannot even be written in a tracked leg). The runner also refuses a venue that has no owner-typed record for this id in venue-clip-consent.json.

playSeconds.description: The settled-playback window the job plays (generator -PlaySeconds). The owner's floor is 20 s, 10 s for a clip of 50 fps or more (HFR-10S-1, owner 2026-10-15); a leg cannot see the clip's fps, so the schema admits the lowest floor and the venue's runner and the app refuse a window under the clip's own. The clip must cover it and the run must advance that many distinct source frames, or the receipt is INVALID.

backends.description: Every playback leg runs as cuda AND cpu on EVERY venue (Amendment 1 A1). 'gl' is reserved and not yet runnable.

scaleFactor.description: The playback scale the leg REQUESTS. The receipt also records the scale the app actually rendered at (effectiveScale, read from the app's own run log); a leg whose run rendered at any other scale than the accepted one ends SCALE_NOT_HONOURED, never PASS.

displayMode.description: OPTIONAL (DUAL-VENUE-DISPLAY-MATRIX-1). The display mode the leg REQUESTS: 'fullscreen' (the default when the field is absent, so every existing leg is unchanged) or 'windowed' (the app's own --windowed: a normal maximized window with chrome). The receipt's display block carries the requested AND the observed mode (read from the app's own gui_smoke.window_placement line) and the window it presented in. FAIL CLOSED: a leg that ran in a different mode than it names (a requested-windowed leg that ran full screen), or that names a mode the run log cannot confirm, ends INVALID (DISPLAY_MODE_NOT_HONOURED), never PASS or FAIL.

acceptedEffectiveScale.description: OPTIONAL, per backend: the scale that backend is KNOWN to render at when it is not scaleFactor (the CUDA texture route clamps every requested scale other than 1 to 1: MainWindowGpuPreviewPolicy.h). A run that renders at exactly this scale passes with the receipt verdict DECLARED_CLAMP and both numbers in its outcomeDetail; any other rendered scale is SCALE_NOT_HONOURED. A leg that wants its requested scale on a backend declares nothing and lists no backend that cannot render it.

gpuFaultInject.description: GPU-DEVICE-LOSS-SELF-HEAL-1 r2: the measured run's injected device loss, <cuda code>@<n-th successful run stage> (MLVAPP_GPU_FAULT_INJECT; generator -GpuFaultInject). Injection only: never a real TDR.

gpuSafeStart.description: GPU-DEVICE-LOSS-SELF-HEAL-1 r2: MLVAPP_GPU_SAFE_START=clear for the measured run (the app clears a persisted safe-start flag at startup; generator -GpuSafeStart).

automationSettingsDir.description: GPU-DEVICE-LOSS-SELF-HEAL-1 r2: a directory NAME under the job's own work dir that every launch of the job shares as its run-scoped settings store (MLVAPP_AUTOMATION_SETTINGS_DIR; generator -AutomationSettingsDir). Created fresh, deleted by proof after the measured run; its INI is published under <artifacts>\self-heal.

gpuPreLaunches.description: GPU-DEVICE-LOSS-SELF-HEAL-1 r2 (needs automationSettingsDir; speed legs only): launches of the measured run's own smoke command, in order, BEFORE PresentMon and the measured run, on the shared store; each '<code>@<n>' injects that device loss, 'none' injects nothing. Each publishes under <artifacts>\self-heal\pre-<n> (generator -GpuPreLaunches).

forceLookAssist.description: SPEED legs only (PLAYBACK-BACHELOR-PRESENT-JITTER-1): force Look Assist on WITHOUT a contact sheet (generator -ForceLookAssist -LookPaceLeg), so no GUI-thread framebuffer grab lands inside the timed Play. A look leg ignores it (its look block forces Look Assist).

lookFlavor.description: With forceLookAssist on a SPEED leg: the Look Assist flavor (generator -LookFlavor).

lookReceipt.description: VENUE-LEG-AGXOFF-UNPACED-HEADROOM-REMEASURE-1: a capture-free pace leg's look receipt, the same instrument as look.receipt (for example AgX off) on a SPEED leg with forceLookAssist, so a look leg's receipt condition has a capture-free twin. Read AS COMMITTED at the admission head and refused LOOK_RECEIPT_UNBOUND unless its bytes hash to lookReceiptSha256 (generator -LookReceiptPath). Never on a look leg (its look block carries the receipt) or without forceLookAssist.

lookReceiptSha256.description: VENUE-LEG-AGXOFF-UNPACED-HEADROOM-REMEASURE-1: sha256 of the committed lookReceipt bytes; legSpecSha256 binds it. The run's summary.json lookReceiptSha256 must equal it (LOOK_RECEIPT_MISMATCH otherwise).

disablePrepPointwiseFast.description: VENUE-LEG-AGXOFF-UNPACED-HEADROOM-REMEASURE-1: run the app with the #680 prep pointwise fast path killed (MLVAPP_DISABLE_PREP_POINTWISE_FAST=1; generator -DisablePrepPointwiseFast), the kill-switch arm of a same-binary fast-path A/B. Absent or false: nothing is set and the job is the text it was before. Any leg.

playbackRenderLookaheadFrames.description: With forceLookAssist on a SPEED leg: the playback render lookahead depth the app runs at (MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_RENDER_LOOKAHEAD_FRAMES; generator -PlaybackRenderLookaheadFrames). Absent: the app's default.

playbackProcessing.description: OPTIONAL (CPU-DUALISO-REDUCED-ISO-NOTCH-1): the app's playback processing (generator -PlaybackProcessing, forwarded by the smoke runner as --playback-processing). 'receipt' turns fast playback processing off, so a cpu leg renders processed8 and the CPU reduced dual-ISO recon can engage; 'subset' is the smoke default. Absent: the job passes nothing (the smoke default).

swapInterval.description: PLAYBACK-VSYNC-DEFAULT-1: the GL swap interval every playback surface requests (MLVAPP_SWAP_INTERVAL; generator -SwapInterval), any leg type. 1 = vsync. Absent: nothing is set and the app keeps its default (1: the VSync setting, which an automation run reads fresh), so the job is the text it was before.

playbackConform.description: HFR-NATIVE-60FPS-FULLRES-1: the high-frame-rate conform arm (MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_CONFORM=1|0; generator -PlaybackConform), any leg type. 'off' plays a clip above the conform threshold at its own rate (the native-HFR arm); 'on' conforms it. The receipt proves the arm was honoured from the app's playback_smoke.conform line, else INVALID (CONFORM_ARM_NOT_HONOURED). Absent: nothing is set and the app keeps its saved setting, so the job is the text it was before.

rawPrefetchDecoders.description: PLAYBACK-LJ92-DECODE-THROUGHPUT-1: the raw-uint16 prefetch decoder count the app runs at (generator -RawPrefetchDecoders). 0 = MLVAPP_DISABLE_RAW_UINT16_PREFETCH=1 (no prefetch); 1..4 = MLVAPP_RAW_UINT16_PREFETCH_DECODERS=<k>. Absent: the app's default (2). Any leg.

disableLookAssist.description: UPSTREAM-CPU-BASELINE-1: run the app with Look Assist OFF (generator -DisableLookAssist -> the smoke runner's -DisableLookAssist -> --no-look-assist; the run fails closed if the app still reports Look Assist enabled). The fork turns Look Assist on for every clip by default, so a no-look leg must ask. Never with forceLookAssist or on a look leg (the generator refuses the pair, typed). Absent: nothing is passed and the app keeps its default.

cudaLaunchTimingMinMs.description: GPU-EVENT153-ROOTCAUSE-2: turns the CUDA backends' per-launch timer on (MLVAPP_CUDA_LAUNCH_TIMING=1) with this per-launch line threshold in ms (MLVAPP_CUDA_LAUNCH_TIMING_MIN_MS; generator -CudaLaunchTimingMinMs). 0 = a line for every launch; the first launch of each stage, every error and the per-stage summaries are always written (to stderr, kept in result.json). Absent: nothing is set, the timer stays OFF and the job is the text it was before. Any leg.

presentTrace.description: PLAYBACK-STARTUP-CATCHUP-BURST-1 r7: turns the app's per-present playback trace on (MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_PRESENT_TRACE=1; generator -PresentTrace): one playback_smoke.present_trace row per presented frame, written to the run log after the Play stops. Absent or false: nothing is set and the job is the text it was before. Any leg.

firstPresentCapture.description: PLAYBACK-STARTUP-WAIT-PREWARM-1: turns the app's first-present identity capture on (MLVAPP_SMOKE_FIRST_PRESENT_CAPTURE=1; generator -FirstPresentCapture): an untimed capture of the paused start frame before the measured Play and one right after the first present's swap, written into the contact-sheet dir as identity-pre-play.png, identity-first-present.png and identity.json (std, mean absolute difference, display frames). The second grab lands inside the measured interval, so such a leg is never counted for timing. Absent or false: nothing is set and the job is the text it was before. Any leg.

warmReuseMissDump.description: PLAYBACK-STARTUP-WAIT-S1-WARM-RECON-DETERMINISM-1 F-diag: turns the app's opt-in warm-reuse miss dump on (MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_WARM_REUSE_MISS_DUMP_DIR=<published artifacts>\warm-reuse-miss; generator -WarmReuseMissDump): when Play's first recon present misses the paused warm's output on content, the app copies both AMaZE inputs to the host inside that present, writes warm.u16, play.u16 and diff.txt there and logs one playback_warm_output_reuse_miss_dump line. The copies land inside the measured interval, so such a leg is never counted for timing. Absent or false: nothing is set and the job is the text it was before. Any leg.

unpaced.description: CUDA-HEADROOM-1: an unpaced throughput leg. Sets MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_UNPACED=1 (an automation run hands the app's pace guard a pace of 0, so no advance waits on the clip's own fps) and passes -DropFrameMode off to the smoke (every frame is rendered and presented; generator -Unpaced). FAIL CLOSED: the leg is INVALID with UNPACED_NOT_HONOURED unless the run log shows playback_smoke.pace_unpaced active=1 drop_frame=0 for the measured session. Absent or false: nothing is set and the job is the text it was before. Any leg.

scope.description: PLAYBACK-SCOPES-OPTION-1: the live scope the GUI smoke forces on for the run (generator -Scope -> the smoke runner's -Scope -> the app's --scope, which also shows the edit area for any scope but none). Absent or 'none': the job passes -Scope none, the text it always was (edit area hidden, no scope). Any leg.

scopeIntervalMs.description: PLAYBACK-SCOPES-OPTION-1: the base interval of the app's playback scope throttle (MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_SCOPE_INTERVAL_MS; generator -ScopeIntervalMs). 0 = no base interval (a scope update every presented frame when the render is fast, upstream's behaviour). Absent: nothing is set and the app keeps its default (150 ms), so the job is the text it was before. Any leg.

scopesDuringPlayback.description: PLAYBACK-SCOPES-OPTION-1 r4: the app's "Scopes During Playback" mode for the run (MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_SCOPES_DURING_PLAYBACK; generator -ScopesDuringPlayback), honoured only in an automation run and disclosed on one log line. The app defaults to hide, which computes no scope while playing, so a scope leg must pin throttled or live. Absent: nothing is set and the job is the text it was before (a build without the setting ignores it). Any leg.

benchAffinityMask.description: BACHELOR-CORE-PARTITION-AB-1: the logical-CPU mask the MEASURED smoke launch runs under (generator -BenchAffinityMask): the job sets its own affinity to it around that one launch and restores it after, so MLVApp inherits it. Needs corePartitionTelemetry; the summary's benchAffinityApplied is true only when the app's first and last observed mask both equal it. Absent: the job text is unchanged.

partitionLoadMask.description: BACHELOR-CORE-PARTITION-AB-1: the CPUs of the MLV-owned synthetic background load (generator -PartitionLoadMask): the telemetry helper runs partitionLoadThreads threads, each streaming read-modify-write over its own 32 MiB buffer, only while MLVApp is alive. Needs benchAffinityMask (no shared CPU) and partitionLoadThreads. Absent: the job text is unchanged.

partitionLoadThreads.description: BACHELOR-CORE-PARTITION-AB-1: the synthetic load's thread count (generator -PartitionLoadThreads), 1..16, only with partitionLoadMask. Absent: the job text is unchanged.

corePartitionTelemetry.description: BACHELOR-CORE-PARTITION-AB-1: starts one bounded helper process (affinity corePartitionHelperMask, or partitionLoadMask when given; BelowNormal) around the measured launch that records the core topology, the app's observed affinity and priority, per-CPU time / frequency / performance / parking counters every 1 s, and the HWiNFO feed rows of the run; publishes core-partition.json and adds the core-partition scalars to the success summary (generator -CorePartitionTelemetry). Needs corePartitionHelperMask. Absent or false: the job text is unchanged.

corePartitionHelperMask.description: BACHELOR-CORE-PARTITION-AB-1: the CPUs the telemetry helper runs on (generator -CorePartitionHelperMask); never a bench CPU. Only with corePartitionTelemetry. Absent: the job text is unchanged.

playbackMaxThreads.description: VENUE-LEG-PLAYBACK-MAX-THREADS-ARG-1: the app's playback worker-thread cap for the run (generator -PlaybackMaxThreads -> the smoke runner's existing -Threads <n>, which sets MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_MAX_THREADS for the app and records playbackMaxThreads in its result.json). FAIL CLOSED: the leg is INVALID (WORKER_THREADS_NOT_HONOURED) unless the measured session's playback_smoke.start worker_threads= and the job's proof fields (playbackMaxThreadsRequested, playbackMaxThreadsSmoke, playbackWorkerThreadsRead) all say n; an unreadable count is never a PASS. Absent: nothing is passed and the job is the text it was before. Any leg.

generatorArgs.description: Generator arguments other than -Venue/-Backend/-ScaleFactor/-SourceCommit/-BuildManifestSha256/-ClipId (the runner sets those).

visualCapture.description: OPTIONAL (PLAYBACK-VISUAL-INSPECTION-1). ABSENT MEANS ON for every speed leg: after the measured Play ends and its numbers are written, the app keeps playing ~3 s UNTIMED and the job keeps window captures (PrintWindow) a reviewer opens -- 6 play frames, the frame on screen the instant Play is paused, and that frame re-rendered by the paused full-quality path -- plus one contact strip. false is the opt-out and needs visualCaptureOptOutReason. A look leg is judged on its contact sheet and never runs this capture.

visualCaptureOptOutReason.description: Why this speed leg keeps no window captures (required with visualCapture false, refused otherwise). Recorded verbatim in the receipt's visual block.

presentTearingExpectedReason.description: CUDA-HEADROOM-1 r2: why PresentMon's AllowsTearing=1 on this leg's presents is the expected result and not a defect. Allowed ONLY on an unpaced leg at swap interval 0 (generatorArgs.unpaced true AND generatorArgs.swapInterval 0), refused otherwise, so a paced or vsync leg can never carry it. The runner and the job ignore it; the hub's playback-health scan reads it from the committed spec named by the receipt's legId to exempt that leg's TEARING flag.

receipt.description: OPTIONAL (LOOK-ASSIST-FILM-FLAVOR-2 r2): a receipt file relative to tools/profiling/dual-venue/. The GUI smoke applies it before playback (--receipt). The runner reads it as COMMITTED at the admission head, never from the working copy. A measurement instrument (for example AgX off, so a capture can be re-graded frame-locked), not a product setting.

receiptSha256.description: sha256 of the committed receipt bytes. legSpecSha256 binds this hash, and so the receipt's bytes; a mismatch refuses the leg (LOOK_RECEIPT_UNBOUND).

look.description: Required when legType is 'look'. Look Assist is FORCED on for a look leg (Amendment 1 A2).

criteria.description: Per venue ROLE (P3) and per backend: criteria evaluated against the metrics copied verbatim from summary.json. An empty list is informational (no gating).
